FROM dbo.FactBookings
WHERE booking_date > CAST('@{activity('LastLoad').output.firstRow.lastload}' AS datetime2)
  AND booking_date <= CAST('@{activity('LatestLoad').output.firstRow.latestload}' AS datetime2)
